# anthropic_workspace_member (Resource)

Manages a user's membership and role within a Claude Console workspace (`/v1/organizations/workspaces/{workspace_id}/members`).



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `user_id` (String) Identifier of the organization user (`user_...`).
- `workspace_id` (String) Identifier of the workspace (`wrkspc_...`).
- `workspace_role` (String) Role of the user in the workspace (`workspace_user`, `workspace_developer`, `workspace_restricted_developer`, `workspace_admin`, `workspace_billing`).

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Composite identifier in the format `workspace_id/user_id`.
- `type` (String) Object type (`workspace_member`).
